summary: Legacy VB6 application with critical modernization needs. High security and maintainability risks due to outdated technology stack and lack of modern safeguards.

hotspots.reason: Direct database access without parameterized queries creates SQL injection vulnerability
No visible modern authentication patterns, likely storing credentials insecurely
Financial transactions without visible audit trails or validation frameworks
VB6 runtime no longer supported, creates deployment and security risks

risks.title: SQL Injection Vulnerability
risks.description: ADO-based database access likely uses string concatenation for SQL queries, creating injection attack vectors

risks.title: Unsupported Runtime Environment
risks.description: VB6 runtime is deprecated and no longer receives security updates from Microsoft

risks.title: No Modern Authentication
risks.description: Banking application lacks modern authentication mechanisms like MFA, OAuth, or secure session management

risks.title: Lack of Audit Trails
risks.description: Financial transactions appear to lack comprehensive logging and audit capabilities
